payload.final_answer: The band described is Simon & Garfunkel. They formed in 1966 and won a Grammy Award for their debut album "Wednesday Morning, 3 A.M." in 1968. After their second album "Sounds of Silence," they attempted to go to London but were refused work permits. One member, Paul Simon, was a singer, songwriter, and producer, while Art Garfunkel was part of the band The Troubadours, which was formed in 1961 and disbanded in 1964. Their third album, released in the early 1970s, is "Bridge Over Troubled Water."
